correctness.rationale: With \(p\) the least prime divisor and \(h=H(n)\), Euler's product formula gives \(n-\varphi(n)\ge n/p\). An exponent-\(h\) prime power gives \(n/p\ge2^{h-1}\). Thus defect at most \(3\) forces \(h\le3\) and \(n/p\le6\), leaving exactly eight composite candidates, whose exact values yield the claimed fibers.
